sentences.text: She was watching for their arrival.
In the meantime, on hearing noise, she went there and saw that all the F.I.R. named accused persons have confined her husband.
In the meantime, Pawan Singh (petitioner) shot on the rib cage (Panjra) of her husband.
Her husband sustained firearm injury and fell down from the Motorcycle.
In the meantime, the co-accused Pahari Singh also fired on him.
Her husband again sustained injury in his chick.
Thereafter, all accused persons fled away from the place of occurrence towards north side.
Her husband died at the spot.
4. Learned senior counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case.

It is further submitted that the petitioner and the co-accused person Pahari Singh are full brothers and they have falsely been implicated in the present case merely because the brother of the petitioner had lodged Tikapatti P.S. Case No. 88 of 2017 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 302, 201 read with Section 34 of the I.P.C. in which the informant's husband (deceased) was an Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.36335 of 2024(4) dt.07-05-2025 accused.

The postmortem report of the deceased suggests four wounds of entry caused by firearms which also suggests that the informant is not an eye witness to the alleged offence as her version does not support the postmortem report.
The petitioner is himself victim in the present case who has been framed in this case.

Learned senior counsel for the petitioner by filing of second supplementary affidavit on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that the co-accused Pahari Singh who is alleged to have fired on the face of the deceased has already been acquitted vide judgment dated 22.08.2024 passed in Sessions Trial No. 39 of 2021, CIS No. 39 of 2021, G.R No.
688 of 2019 arising out of Tikapatti P.S. Case No. 21 of 2019 by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge-XII, Civil Court, Purnea, annexed as Annexure/P/3 to the second supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the petitioner.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the petitioner has six criminal antecedents and in two cases, he is on bail as stated in paragraph no. 3 of the present bail application.
The petitioner is in custody in this case since 27.03.2023.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State and learned counsel for the informant have vehemently opposed the prayer for bail petition of the petitioner.

Learned counsel for the informant has further submitted that the petitioner and other co-accused person Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.36335 of 2024(4)
dt.07-05-2025 Pahari Singh have fired on the informant's husband, due to which, he died.

6. Vide order dated 25.03.2025, a report with regard to the present stage of trial of the present case was called for and in compliance thereof, the learned District and Additional Sessions Judge-4th,
Purnea, vide its Letter No. 276/2025 dated 05.05.2025 has sent a report with regard to the present stage of the case to this Court in which it has been reported that the charge has been framed against the petitioner.
